record.label: Spectral amplification baseline for the energy window
record.statement: The authors adapt the published ground-state estimate to the 0.1 Ha energy window and integrate later compilation methods. The resulting estimate is about 1.09 trillion qubit–T on 481 logical qubits.
record.boundary: The adjusted cost is $481\times49{,}056\times11{,}517\times4=1{,}087{,}017{,}579{,}648$ qubit–T. The factors are logical qubits, walk steps, Toffolis per step and $T$ gates per Toffoli. The ratio to the proved circuit bound of 436,509,499,221 qubit–T rounds to 2.49. The published ground-state estimate corresponds to about 2.26 trillion qubit–T.
